Pair all 1ms before-physics and world-update-end samples by actual clock and iteration for all three robots during the entire sampled task interval; finite data, unique sequence, exact no-gap coverage.
Bind model/canonical/base origin and CoG pose/velocity, wheel feedback and motor vel/fmax reads, generated SDF, observer/profile library source/binary and actual load mapping.

Run the original frozen sampled physical consumer as diagnostic, retaining FAIL/nonrest and absent stimulation; no threshold or eligibility relaxation.

on_failure: Preserve every attempt and all originals; no same-freeze blind retries. Native/infrastructure/coverage/source/config failure blocks the later diagnostic. A correctly captured original physical FAIL is a scientific outcome and does not itself invalidate a predeclared comparison.

fixed_pair_rule: Run both fixed cases once if preceding native/source/config/1ms-capture/strict-close checks succeed, even when correctly captured baseline physical FAIL is absent or present. No sample-dependent selection/retry.
readiness_scope: All sources/configs/build/CPU artifacts finalized. Native admission additionally requires clean committed pushed exact40 HEAD and actual successful preflight; readiness is not native or physical-response PASS.
